## Hi! I'm Jules Walzer-Goldfeld 👋

I graduated from Williams College in 2023 with a double major in computer science and math. After my undergraduate education, I spent a year in Spain teaching computer science, among other topics, at a vocational school. I've also had the good fortune to join batches at the [Recurse Center](https://www.recurse.com/) in summer of 2022 and fall of 2024 in which I spent time building out a number of projects, like [these](./work.qmd)!

Last year, I helped out in the Michigan Dems 2024 campaign, writing some texting scripts and mostly organzing volunteer door-knockers and phone bankers. More recently I worked as a maintainer for an in-house Student Information Service for a local high school, which entailed a full-stack React/NextJS project deployed on Vercel.

Last fall, I worked on Python open-source resources for [Posit](https://posit.co/) and currently I'm supporting data scientists at the [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/dev) in their quest for data-powered development.

- 🔭 My role now involves the development of resources for data scientists at the World Bank.
- 🔭 I had previously been working on a supplemental [Great Tables](https://github.com/posit-dev/great-tables) package called [gt-extras](https://github.com/posit-dev/gt-extras)!
- 🌱 I’m currently learning how to toy around with R Shiny apps, one of which can be found [here](https://jules-dev.shinyapps.io/Marion-Stokes-Tapes-Dashboard/).
- 💬 I’m looking to collaborate on [gt-extras](https://github.com/posit-dev/gt-extras), please submit issues and PR's!
- 👯 I spend my time climbing, playing soccer and table tennis, and volunteering at a weekly legal clinic.
